about: Anti-bloat rubric (Rule 27). Every candidate feature is scored 0–5 on each criterion. keep if value - complexityCost >= threshold.keep; otherwise apply the first applicable remedy.

criteria.label: Player fantasy
criteria.question: Does it reinforce what the player wants to feel?

criteria.label: Decision value
criteria.question: Does it create interesting decisions with tradeoffs?

criteria.label: System connection
criteria.question: Does it interact with other mechanics (inputs AND outputs)?

criteria.label: Feedback
criteria.question: Will the player understand its effects?

criteria.label: Frequency
criteria.question: Will the player actually use it regularly or at key moments?

criteria.label: Uniqueness
criteria.question: Is it NOT already provided by another system?

complexityCost.label: Complexity cost
complexityCost.question: Mental load added (new screen = 2, new resource = 1.5, new parameterized action = 1, new meter = 1, automated/background = 0.3).
